findings.detail: export favicon source is normalized to viewBox256 with fractional translate/scale. 16px is no longer aligned: 98 partial-alpha pixels vs6 native; bbox touches all canvas edges; lower clear holes shrink from4 pixels each to1. PNG matches the exported SVG, so source normalization is the cause.
findings.resolution: Final export preserves original16×16 viewBox. Direct native render, final PNG and decoded ICO match full RGBA bytes at16/32/48. Original discrepancy remains in export_initial.

findings.detail: Native pixel favicon is square-only; circular crop removes6 opaque pixels at16px. Use main pin-symbol, which loses zero alpha under circle crop at16/32/64/256.
Fold master two lower tips exceed radius128 by0.748 units; at256 crop intersects2 nonzero pixels (alpha area1.267). Square use is unaffected.
Audit near-miss angles appear only in outlined italic letterforms/lockups. Do not snap font outlines merely to satisfy a geometric heuristic.

visual_observations: Pin master shows one upper and two lower square window modules. Cut corners point into the central opening. At16px the main master has gray antialiasing; native16px favicon is visibly cleaner.
Fold silhouette is readable at16px, but the three separating seams look thin and gray;64px and above is more stable.
The pin/fold lockups and fangs wordmark render without missing shapes or visibly broken outlines.
Circular crop of native favicon visibly cuts the lower outer corners. Main pin symbol retains them.
limitations: Raster evidence uses rsvg-convert, not every browser rasterizer or DPR.
No uniqueness, trademark availability, audience recognition, preference or real-world adoption claim is established by these checks.
No source/assets changed; only checks/asset-qa.json and checks/asset-qa.md are authored by this reviewer.
export_initial is retained historical pre-fix evidence; export_final and top-level status describe the final verified files. Original circle-use constraints still apply.
